items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was in that great band that Chick had when he had -- to me it was one of the greatest bands he ever had is when he had Dick Vance, Bobby Stark, and Taft Jordan in the trumpet section.

ctx.x: He was in Chick Webb's band, right?

Oh, definitely, definitely. He was in that great band that Chick had when he had -- to me it was one of the greatest bands he ever had is when he had Dick Vance, Bobby Stark, and Taft Jordan in the trumpet section. That was fantastic.
Can you think of any of the other trumpet players along that line that we haven't -- do you remember them -- that impressed you, any of them?
